description: Camille (her build from btl_upload_40d9a3c1da37: P3, Blessing of Lustrous Carmine, three Frontiers pieces) with Gilberta vs Rhodagn, both ultimates charged. Camille's battle skill inflicts Heat and leaves the Vesperwings hovering (Weakness, Heat Susceptibility; her weapon's team Heat DMG on the hit itself); Gilberta's battle skill turns the Heat into Corrosion, which opens Camille's combo: on the hovering target it explodes 0.4 s after its third hit, gives the team a Link stack (talent 1) that Gilberta's ultimate then uses (×1.2), heals Camille (two Bloodfount Revival layers each, a quarter of it for Gilberta) and its natural SP gives the team the weapon's ATK. Camille's ultimate inflicts Heat and arms Hunter Pursuit, which the battle-skill button then casts: a combo-kind skill with no combo window, its own Link, explosion and heal.
